class.name: LevelMap
class.description: LevelMap holds a set of [LevelBrush] child nodes and provides a live editor preview plus a bake step that emits a [MeshInstance3D] with trimesh collision and an [OccluderInstance3D].

method.name: refresh
method.description: Flags the live preview for rebuild.
